name: FIL314
fix_description: The condition in hourBurn is inverted: "if (hourBurnTime + 3600 < block.timestamp) return" should be "if (hourBurnTime + 3600 > block.timestamp) return". Currently it only executes burn when less than an hour has passed, allowing repeated calls in one tx to drain the contract balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short, direct exploit against a single vulnerable contract with no flash loan, routing, or cross-protocol interaction. The attack flow is simple: buy tokens, repeatedly call an exposed burn/deflation function, then sell back in a loop, which fits an obvious business-logic flaw an auditor could script quickly.
